text.tspan: IAM audit: inventory → usage → exposure → continuous rules → fix
Fix: delete unused users/keys/roles · enforce MFA · IAM Identity Center (SSO) for humans · OIDC roles for CI
· remove * actions/resources · ExternalId on third-party trusts · SCPs + permission boundaries · policies generated from CloudTrail
aws iam generate-credential-report → get-credential-report --query Content --output text | base64 -d
aws iam generate-service-last-accessed-details --arn <role> · aws iam get-account-authorization-details
Many accounts: Organizations + delegated admin for Security Hub, Access Analyzer and a Config aggregator.
